American IPA \"Sa Man\" 330ml (Island B: An American-style IPA, 330ml. Strongly hoppy and properly bitter, with citrus and pine on the nose and a dry finish.
Cacao Tablea Roses 200g (Naturalmind): Ground cacao pressed into discs, 200g. Bitter and intensely chocolatey, thick in the cup — far darker than drinking chocolate.
Cawarra Cabernet Merlot 750ml (Lindemann: Cabernet and Merlot blended, 750ml. Plummy and soft with gentle tannin — round, fruity and easy to drink young.
Cawarra Shiraz Cabernet 750ml (Lindemann: Shiraz and Cabernet blended, 750ml. Dark plum and blackberry with a touch of pepper, soft and rounded rather than firm.
Coffee Beans Arabica (Naturalmind): Arabica beans. Smoother and more aromatic than robusta, with a gentle fruit acidity and far less bitterness.
Coffee Beans Barako (Naturalmind): Barako — the Philippine liberica bean. Strong and bold with a woody, almost floral aroma, and a heavier body than arabica.
Coffee Beans Excelsa (Naturalmind): Excelsa beans. Tart and fruity over a dark, woody depth — the most unusual-tasting bean here, and the most divisive.
Coffee Beans House Blend (Naturalmind): The house blend. Balanced and rounded, with no single note pushed forward — built for the everyday cup.
Coffee Beans Robusta (Naturalmind): Robusta beans. Strong, bitter and full-bodied, with roughly twice the caffeine of arabica and a heavier, oilier texture.
Coffee Drink 180ml (Nescafe): Chilled ready-to-drink coffee, 180ml, in three kinds. Sweet and milky rather than strong — a cold drink more than a coffee.
English Breakfast Tea (McCoy): A strong, malty black tea blend. Brisk and full-bodied, robust enough to take milk without disappearing into it.
Green Tea (McCoy): Green tea. Light and grassy with a clean, mild bitterness and none of the malt of black tea.
La Morena 330 ml(Island Brewers): A dark bottled beer, 330ml. Maltier and fuller-bodied than a pale lager, with roasted notes behind it.
Premio Red Wine 750ml (Santa Carolina): A Chilean red, 750ml. Medium-bodied and fruity, soft and easy-drinking with little tannin.
Raw Ceremonial Cacao 250g (Naturalmind): Raw cacao, unroasted and unsweetened, 250g. Intensely bitter and earthy, with none of the sweetness of eating chocolate.
Red Wine 750ml (Baron de Valls): A Spanish red, 750ml. Medium-bodied and dry, with ripe red fruit and a soft finish.
Red Wine 750ml (Pluvium): A Spanish red, 750ml. Dry and medium-bodied, smooth with dark fruit and gentle tannin.
Rothbury Estate: Australian wine in three styles — two reds and a Chardonnay. Fruit-forward and easy-drinking rather than complex.
White Wine 750ml (Pluvium): A Spanish white, 750ml. Dry and crisp, with citrus and green apple and a clean finish.
Artisanal Hot Sauce 150ml (Peculiar): Small-batch hot sauce, 150ml, in three blends. Ask at the counter which is the hottest — the names give nothing away.
Artisanal Olio Piccante 250ml (Peculiar): Olive oil infused with chilli, 250ml. Warm and gently hot, the heat carried through the oil rather than sitting on top of it.
Artisanal Spiced Vinegar 500ml (Peculiar: Vinegar steeped with spices, 500ml. Sharp and aromatic, the spice taking the hard edge off the sourness.
Course Mustard 255g (Kühne): Wholegrain mustard, 255g. Mild and tangy, with whole seeds that pop between the teeth — far gentler than Dijon.
Dijon Mustard 370g (Bornier): French-style Dijon, 370g. Smooth and sharp, with a strong clean heat that hits the nose rather than the tongue.
Double Cheddar Cheese Sauce 439g (Ragu): Ready-made cheddar sauce, 439g. Thick, salty and mild, pourable straight from the jar and smooth when warmed.
Hormel Chili with Beans 425g: Tinned chilli con carne with beans, 425g. Thick and mildly spiced — savoury rather than hot.
Liver Pate 250g (Sausage Guy): Liver pâté, 250g. Smooth and rich, the deep mineral flavour of liver rounded off by fat.
Original Dijon Mustard 185g(Kühne): Dijon mustard, 185g. Smooth and sharp, with a strong clean heat.
Peanut Butter Creamy 800g (Herman): Smooth peanut butter, 800g. Thick, sweet and nutty, with no pieces in it.
Peanut Butter Crunchy 800g (Herman): Crunchy peanut butter, 800g. Thick and nutty, with chopped peanuts through it.
Pickled Gherkins 670g (Kühne): Pickled gherkins, 670g. Crunchy and sharply sour, with a little sweetness behind the vinegar.
Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce 440ml (Crying T: Sriracha, 440ml. Hot, garlicky and a little sweet, thick enough to pour slowly.
Yellowfin Tuna 185g (Delimondo): Yellowfin tuna, 185g, in three styles — olive oil, spiced olive oil, and chunks in brine. Firm, meaty flakes rather than mush.
Beef Stew Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A seasoning blend for beef stew. Savoury and herb-led, with pepper, onion and bay sitting behind it.
Coffee Steak Rub 100g (Muscat Blends): A steak rub built on ground coffee. Dark and bitter-sweet, with salt and pepper behind it.
Fish Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A seasoning blend for fish. Bright and herbal, with lemon, dill and pepper running through it.
Grilled Chicken Rub 100g (Muscat Blends): A rub for chicken. Savoury and lightly smoky, with paprika, garlic and dried herbs.
Himalayan Pink Salt Fine Grind 250g (Gre: Finely ground pink rock salt, 250g. Clean and faintly mineral, a touch softer in taste than sea salt.
Pangasinan Organic Rock Salt 500g (The S: Coarse rock salt, 500g. Clean and strongly salty, with crystals big enough to crunch between the teeth.
Peri-Peri Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A peri-peri blend built on African bird's eye chilli. Hot and tangy, with lemon and garlic cutting through the heat.
Pork Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A seasoning blend for pork. Savoury and lightly sweet, with sage, pepper and garlic running through it.
Salmon Rub & Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blen: A rub for salmon. Herbal and bright, with dill, lemon and pepper leading.
Steak Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A steak blend. Coarse, peppery and salty, with garlic and onion through it.
Texas BBQ Blend 100g (Muscat Blends): A Texas-style barbecue blend. Heavy on black pepper and paprika — savoury and smoky rather than sweet.
Turkey Seasoning 100g (Muscat Blends): A seasoning blend for turkey. Herbal and warming, with sage, thyme and pepper leading.
Cacao Almond Granola 200g (Naturalmind): Granola with cacao and almond, 200g. Crunchy clusters, nutty with a dark chocolate bitterness.
Classic Walnut Granola 200g (Naturalmind: Granola with walnuts, 200g. Crunchy and lightly sweet, with the rich oiliness walnuts bring.
Crunchy Granola 275g (Fit & Flex): Crunchy granola, 275g, in four flavours. Firm clusters that hold their crunch in milk.
Crunchy Granola 340g (Emco): Crunchy granola, 340g, in crispy caramel and triple chocolate. Sweeter and more dessert-like than the plainer granolas.
Granola 400g (Yava): Granola, 400g, in tropical fruits and coconut banana. Crunchy and fruity, lightly sweet.
High Protein Power Oats 400g (Fit & Flex: Oats with added protein, 400g, in peanut butter choco and honey. Thick and filling, and clearly sweetened.
Muesli 210g (Fit & Flex): Muesli, 210g, in three kinds. Soft rather than crunchy — oats, fruit and nuts left unbaked.
Muesli 350g (Sante): Muesli, 350g, traditional and fruit. Plain and lightly sweet, with the oats leading.
Müsli Crunchy 375g (Emco): Crunchy muesli, 375g, in three fruit kinds. Baked into clusters, sweeter and crisper than plain muesli.
Organic Coconut Flakes (Coco Heaven): Coconut flakes. Dry, crisp and mildly sweet, with a clear coconut flavour.
Signature Instant Oatmeal 500G (Picky Fa: Plain instant oatmeal, 500g. Soft, mild and lightly sweet.
Beef Pastrami: Beef cured with pepper and coriander, then smoked. Peppery and smoky with a firm bite, drier and leaner than most cold cuts.
Beef Salami: Air-dried beef salami. Dense and tangy, salty with a firm chew.
Chicken Ham: Cooked chicken ham. Pale and tender with a light, clean flavour — the gentlest ham here.
Cooked Ham: Cooked pork ham. Mild, lightly salty and tender — the plainest of the hams, and the easiest to put with anything.
Florentiner: A finely ground German-style cold cut. Smooth and mild, lightly seasoned rather than spicy or smoky.
Lyoner: Very finely ground pork sausage sold as a cold cut. Smooth, pale and barely seasoned — the mildest slice here.
Meat Loaf (Sliced): Baked fine-ground meat loaf. Mild and savoury, smooth inside with a browned crust at the edge.
Mortadella: Very finely ground pork studded with cubes of white fat. Silky and mild, delicately peppered.
Pepperoni Lyoner: Lyoner with pepperoni worked through it. Smooth and mild like plain Lyoner, with pockets of gentle spice.
Polish (Beef Cold Cut): A beef cold cut in the Polish style. Savoury and garlicky, coarser and firmer than ham.
Turkey Ham: Cooked turkey ham. Pale and tender with a light, clean flavour.
Australian Veal Beef Liver: Veal liver, finer-grained and milder than liver from a full-grown cow. Rich and faintly sweet, with the deep mineral note liver is bought for.
Beef and Lamb Kofta: Beef and lamb, seasoned and shaped into kofta. Juicy and gently spiced — fuller than a plain beef patty, without a strong lamb flavour.
Beef Burger Patties 2-pack: Ground beef pressed into two patties, in three seasonings. Loose-textured and beef-forward rather than springy.
Brazilian Ground Beef (from Chuckeye): Grass-fed chuck eye, coarsely ground. Deeply beefy, with enough fat running through it to stay rich rather than dry.
Brazilian Ground Beef (from Ribeye): Grass-fed ribeye, coarsely ground. Fattier than the chuck eye grind, with a fuller and more buttery beef flavour.
Lamb Burger 2- pack: Ground lamb pressed into two patties. Richer and more distinctly flavoured than beef, with the sweetness lamb fat brings.
Ostrich Ground 1kg (Big Bird): Ground ostrich. Dark red and very lean, closer to beef than to poultry, with a cleaner and slightly sweeter flavour.
Ostrich Steak (Big Bird): Ostrich steak — dark red meat with almost no fat in it. Tender and mild, beef-like but lighter and a touch sweeter.
USDA Choice Angus Ribeye (St. Helens): Angus ribeye graded USDA Choice. Grain-fed and well marbled, so it eats richer and sweeter than grass-fed beef.
USDA Choice Black Angus Ribeye (Demkota): Black Angus ribeye graded USDA Choice. Generous marbling through the eye gives it a buttery, full beef flavour.
USDA Choice Black Angus Ribeye(Nebraska): Black Angus ribeye graded USDA Choice. Grain-fed and well marbled — rich and juicy, mild rather than gamey.
Almond Milk Chocolate 100g (Marini 1928): Milk chocolate with whole almonds, 100g. Sweet and creamy, the nuts giving crunch against a soft bar.
California Dried Prunes Pitted 120g (Nat: Pitted dried prunes, 120g. Soft, chewy and deeply sweet, with a dark caramel flavour.
Coconut Chips 60g (Coco Heaven): Toasted coconut chips, 60g, in three kinds. Crisp and nutty-sweet; the chilli one carries a mild heat.
Dark Chocolate 100g (Marini 1928): Dark chocolate, 100g. Bitter and deep, far less sweet than milk chocolate.
Naturals Potato Chips 100g (Lorenz): Thin, crisp potato crisps, 100g, in three kinds. The rosemary and balsamic ones are aromatic rather than sharp.
Pistacchios Unsalted 454g (Wonderful): Unsalted pistachios in the shell, 454g. Sweet and buttery with a soft crunch, and no salt on them.
Roasted Peanuts in Shell (Sausage Guy): Roasted peanuts still in the shell. Warm and nutty, shelled by hand as you eat them.
Roasted Sunflower Seeds Spiced Flavor 13: Spiced roasted sunflower seeds, 130g, eaten from the shell. Savoury and lightly spiced.
Toasted Garlic Bread 150g (Switsis): Toasted garlic bread slices, 150g, in two kinds. Hard, crunchy and garlicky-sweet.
Chicken Boneless Legs 2kg (Seara): Boneless chicken leg meat, 2kg. Darker and juicier than breast, with a fuller chicken flavour.
Duck Breast(Dalee): Duck breast with a thick layer of fat under the skin. Dark, close-grained meat with a deep, faintly gamey flavour.
Whole Brazilian Chicken 1.1kg (Seara): A whole chicken, around 1.1kg. Mild and tender, with pale breast meat and darker, richer legs.
Whole Brazilian Chicken 1.3kg (Seara): A whole chicken, around 1.3kg — the larger of the two sizes. Mild and tender, with pale breast and darker, richer legs.
Whole Chicken Leg 2kg (Coopavel): Whole chicken legs, thigh and drumstick together, 2kg. Dark meat, juicier and more strongly flavoured than breast.
Whole Turkey (Carolina): A whole turkey. Pale breast meat with darker legs, milder than chicken and with little fat through it.
Bambi Spring Roll 200g(Lumpia Wrapper): Lumpia wrappers, 200g — thin sheets of plain pastry. Almost tasteless on their own, since they are the wrapper and not the filling.
Coconut Wraps 5pcs (Coco Heaven): Five thin wraps made from coconut, in four kinds. Pliable and faintly sweet, with a clear coconut taste.
Tortilla Wraps (Liberty): Soft flour tortillas, in white and wholewheat. Pliable and mild; the wholewheat ones taste nuttier and eat a little heavier.
Pie (Zac's Pie House): Hand-sized pies in twelve fillings — beef, pork, vegetarian, breakfast and two sweet ones. Short, flaky pastry around a thick filling.
